title: EverList Hub API Changelog & Versioning Policy

versioning_policy.scheme: Additive changes (new fields, new endpoints) may land without a version bump; breaking changes (removed/renamed fields or endpoints, changed semantics) ship under a new path prefix (/v2/) or a new media type.
versioning_policy.deprecation: Deprecated endpoints stay functional for at least 90 days and are announced via this changelog, the OpenAPI document (deprecated: true) and llms.txt before removal.
versioning_policy.contract: /openapi.json is normative and test-enforced: every documented route is really handled; the spec cannot lie about a route.
versioning_policy.idempotency: Writes carry an Idempotency-Key; replays return the original result.

entries.summary: ChatGPT plugin package published in repo; legal pages /terms, /imprint, /support live; AGB v2.1.
MCP server registered in the official MCP Registry (io.github.everlist-hq/everlist-hub, remote streamable-http, no-auth).
ChatGPT Actions spec (/openapi-actions.json), Layer-1 AI findability (JSON-LD, robots, llms.txt, sitemap).

note: Historical entries predate this changelog's creation; they are backfilled from the worklog. Entries are added with every shipped change touching the public wire.
